title: Veggie Salsa Verde
method: Place all the herbs into a food processor with the capers, garlic, mustard and vinegar and whizz until finely chopped.
Add the olive oil and pulse again briefly.
Season with salt and pepper. Taste and adjust the vinegar or mustard if needed.
Transfer to a jar or bowl and refrigerate until needed.
notes: An Italian green herb sauce. Serve alongside fish, grilled chicken, roasted vegetables or with crusty bread. Keeps in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
